rule: drop any co-occurrence pair whose endpoint is shorter than 3 characters, and any self-pair (entity_a == entity_b)
note: The drop rule is deterministic, so the dropped pair rows are fully characterised by this rule plus the entity list in entities_dropped_short.csv. entities_extracted.csv is left unfiltered on purpose: it is the raw extraction record, and the 3-character rule applies to the graded cleaned/network outputs.
